Corporate page: "We advise on inbound and outbound mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, entry strategy and strategic alliances", working with "domestic and international investors, banks, promoters and entrepreneurs"; "Tier 1 law firm for Corporate/M&A – Chambers and Partners; The Legal500 (since 2016)".
